blocks.text: Whether you’re watching a movie or capturing the moment, your stories matter. Make the most of them with the new moto g. Experience cinematic entertainment on a super-bright 6.7" 120Hz display1 backed by powerful stereo speakers with Bass Boost. Capture sharper photos and videos day or night with a 50MP2 Quad Pixel camera system. Enjoy superfast 5G performance thanks to a fast processor and RAM Boost. Work and play all day with a 5000mAh battery, then get hours of power in just minutes with TurboPowerTM charging.3,4 All this in a stylish yet durable vegan leather design with tons of storage, so there’s always room for your stories. moto g makes it matter.
